summary: SU Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting its dismissal of Marcum Asia CPAs LLP as independent auditor and engagement of Guangdong Prouden CPAs GP, effective July 8, 2026. No disagreements or reportable events occurred, though prior material weaknesses in internal controls were noted. This auditor change is a routine corporate event, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions apply.
